name: akylla-gestao
description: Akylla Gestão - SaaS multiempresa de gestão para pequenos negócios

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:whatsapp && npm run dev --workspace @petflow/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run build:whatsapp && npm run dev --workspace @petflow/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:whatsapp && npm run build --workspace @petflow/api && npm run build --workspace @petflow/web && npm run build --workspace @petflow/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build:whatsapp && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/worker
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build:whatsapp && vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts
scripts.bootstrap:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run bootstrap:admin --workspace @petflow/api
